title: Encoding arithmetic gates
statement: Encode each arithmetic gate as a Boolean list using a three-bit operation tag followed by its parameters: an input variable uses tag $000$ and the unary natural-number encoding of its index; the constant $1$ uses tag $001$; addition uses tag $010$ followed by the encodings of its two operand indices; subtraction uses tag $011$ followed by those encodings; and multiplication uses tag $100$ followed by those encodings. The unary encoding of a natural number $k$ consists of $k$ true bits followed by one false bit.
hypotheses_covered: Variable indices lie in the finite index set of size $n$
